S. 4321, Another Act of 2025

March 12, 2025

S. 4321 would authorize appropriations for the Department of Transportation to carry out a new grant program for rural broadband infrastructure. CBO estimates that implementing the bill would cost $1.4 billion over the 2025-2030 period, assuming appropriation of the necessary amounts.

In addition, CBO estimates that enacting S. 4321 would not affect direct spending or revenues; therefore, pay-as-you-go procedures do not apply. CBO estimates that enacting the bill would not increase net direct spending or on-budget deficits by more than $5 billion in any of the four consecutive 10-year periods beginning in 2036.
